content.short: Huff Virtual Machine is an EVM hypervisor for arbitrary EVM bytecode execution.
content.description: Written in Huff and dependent on Foundry's Forge, Huff Virtual Machine acts as a hypervisor that can also function as a library. Through the HyVM library, developers can invoke delegateCall to load, interpret, and execute smart contract bytecode inside a controlled runtime. This setup supports running custom tests on a dedicated test instance, enabling validation of bytecode behavior and experimentation without affecting live deployments. It provides a modular, reusable component suitable for testing, debugging, and validating smart contract interactions within isolated environments.
